_comment: Fuzzy narration lexicon (ROBLOX VIDEO FACTORY, 22 Nov 2026). Whisper mis-hears proper nouns and numbers in predictable ways; these variants count as the canonical term. If the fuzzy check FAILs on a term that is really a mis-hearing, add the variant here and re-run — never override a FAIL by hand. 'proper_nouns' lists the script's proper nouns that must be recognised (Persona is matched exactly as 'persona'; if Whisper ever respells it, add the respelling to 'variants'). Number words are covered by 'numbers' (thirteen=13, sixteen=16, twelve=12, fifteen=15, nine=9, six=6) — 'twelve-year-old' tokenises to twelve/year/old, so 'twelve' resolves via 'numbers'. 'pronunciation_sensitive': words whose pronunciation the voice may blur — they are NEVER legitimised through a variant. If Whisper does not hear such a word EXACTLY, the word is not counted as validated: it goes on the gate report's listen list (heard form + timestamp) and the narration check FAILs on it. The owner listens and decides; the gate never passes a word it cannot confirm. (22 Nov 2026: 'selfie' was heard as 'sucky' by small, 'study' by base, 'set' by tiny — three different guesses, all low-probability — so the voice itself is unclear on that word. 'sucky'/'study' were briefly added as variants to make the gate pass; that was wrong and is removed here.) Contractions ('you are' -> 'you\'re') are expanded in narration_lexicon.py, not here.
